incarnation: Spyro Reignited Trilogy (2018), main quadrupedal Spyro design by Toys for Bob / Activision
visualLocks: Spyro Reignited Trilogy2018 only. No Skylanders, Legend of Spyro, Realm Beyond2026 or generic adult dragon identity.
Exactly four dragon legs/paws plus two separate batlike wings attached behind shoulders; no human arms, hands, feet or humanoid torso. Keep the small youthful source body and large expressive head.

Purple hide with subtle scale patches, violet irises/white sclerae, wide short rounded muzzle and thick arched purple brows. Two nostrils; cheek shape and friendly asymmetric expression from the official hero.
Two long segmented golden-yellow horns that sweep upward/backward, central golden crest and small gold dorsal spines; no ears or extra horns invented.
Golden-orange segmented throat/belly underside; orange wing membranes with golden structural edges, purple tail and curled golden-orange arrow/flame-shaped tail tip.
Broad compact paws with ivory/pale gray claws. Never convert claws into yellow jewelry or fingers. Whole wings, tail tip, horns and paws remain inside frame with positive margins.
All themes family safe, nonromantic, source age/proportions unchanged; nonhuman source has no clothing in canonical slots. Explicit service costume/WhatIf variants retain quadrupedal anatomy.
